summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and retail developments, reflecting a dynamic landscape in India's legal and business sectors.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court upheld the trademark for 'Benne' restaurant, reinforcing brand protection in the food industry.
The Delhi High Court ruled only the Supreme Court can declare its judgments as non-precedential.
Eternal's Q2 profit surged 92.3% YoY to Rs 125 crore, driven by robust performance in Zomato and Blinkit.
Blinkit aims to expand to 3,500 stores by March 2027, focusing on growth in small cities.
Mukesh Ambani's Jio is set to launch India's largest-ever IPO, signaling major developments in the digital economy.
